meta.description: API throughput baselines for core ApexMail API endpoints. Values represent sustained requests per second under normal load on a standard GitHub Actions runner with local backing services.

auth_login.description: Sustained throughput for POST /v1/auth/login. Limited by bcrypt cost factor and database connection pool.

email_send.description: Sustained throughput for POST /v1/email/send. Includes payload validation, spam scanning, and queue submission overhead.

health_liveness.description: Sustained throughput for GET /v1/health/liveness. In-process check, no external dependencies — highest throughput endpoint.

health_readiness.description: Sustained throughput for GET /v1/health/readiness. Includes database and cache health checks.

combined_journey.description: Sustained throughput for the combined journey test (10% liveness + 10% readiness + 30% auth + 50% email send). Realistic traffic mix.
